text: We know why patients delay or miss cancer care. Research shared with us in this challenge shows it: fear, costs, and health literacy.
Most cancer patients in Finland are around seventy, and one in three people over seventy-five is not online.
Meet CareCatalyst, for Finland's wellbeing services counties. They already hold the appointment data. Now they see who is stuck, and can ask why: for example, with a simple phone call to Eero.
Counties pay once. Updates, once. No subscription. Research partners, companies like AstraZeneca, could fund the rest, and receive only anonymised, aggregated patterns, so research can adapt.
But we go one step further. The center of gravity is shifting. Just as everyone has a phone today, soon everyone will have a personal agent.
